scientific_question: Does allocating cumulative effective-evidence energy by item, rather than storing one global scalar, close the potential dynamics and reproduce remote field shape?
v2_diagnosis: The scalar history state robustly improves one-step prediction and restores total remote magnitude, but worsens remote field MSE and does not preserve rollout or behavior categories. History-dependent gain is informative, but its relational allocation is insufficient.
primary_hypothesis: An item-wise evidence-energy ledger q_t preserves where confidence accumulated. Its interaction with current evidence can allocate history-dependent updates across the global potential while keeping fitted capacity identical to v2.
claim_boundary: A pass supports the coupled reduced state (s_t,q_t,a_t) within the frozen eight-item scope. It does not identify q_t as human confidence, Bayesian precision, a biological state, or a unique algorithm. Failure closes task-derived count, coverage, energy, time, and block ledgers and redirects to a P_t-derived latent-state audit.

frozen_state_equations.local_state: Reuse the exact v1 edge-plus-Gram local algorithm without modification.
frozen_state_equations.capacity_match: A and B are each 8 by 8, exactly matching v2 parameter count; any difference is state allocation, not fitted capacity.
frozen_state_equations.information_boundary: q_t uses only prior effective support evidence by item. It contains no pair ID ledger, query, label, true order, Liu behavior, posterior, P_t, L_t, hidden state, time, block, or network seed.

data_fit_and_execution.development: Reuse only valid slices of the frozen v1 NPZ for the exact 2101/2102/2103 leave-one-backbone-out folds; no neural development re-extraction.
data_fit_and_execution.features: Concatenate x_t and q_t elementwise-multiplied by x_t.
data_fit_and_execution.target: s_(t+1)-s_t in raw centered potential units.
data_fit_and_execution.fit: One float64 closed-form ridge regression with lambda=1e-6, no scaling, optimizer, restart, selection, or tuning.
data_fit_and_execution.preservation: Fit once on all 384 development episodes, then reuse the exact v2 Liu preservation interface on untouched 2104 and 2105 with only the registered rollout function changed.
data_fit_and_execution.runtime: GPU plus one PyTorch intraop and interop thread for Liu replay; CPU is allowed for the closed-form fit.

comparators.accumulator: Refit the frozen v1 accumulator on the same training fold.
comparators.v2_scalar: Read held-out v2 metrics from the frozen result without refitting.
comparators.local: Exact K a_T and the identity-kernel diagnostic remain unchanged.

primary_pass_rules.integrity: All v1/v2 sources, artifacts, preservation checkpoints/gains, valid slices, padding, gauge, parameters, runtime, and local exactness pass.
primary_pass_rules.one_step: In every held-out seed NRMSE is at most 0.50, MSE is at most 0.80 times accumulator, the paired interval lies below zero, and MSE is lower than frozen v2.
primary_pass_rules.trajectory: In every held-out seed median prefix and terminal cosine are at least 0.95, order agreement at least 0.90, and centered RMSE ratio at most 0.50.
primary_pass_rules.remote: In every held-out seed influence correlation is at least 0.70, magnitude ratio is in [0.50,1.50], and remote MSE is below both accumulator and frozen v2.
primary_pass_rules.preservation: The exact v1 double-dissociation and all nine behavior flag pairs pass independently in both 2104 and 2105.

outcome_tree.potential_plus_item_history_algorithm: All links pass. Promote (s_t,q_t,a_t) within scope and freeze cross-task generalization.
outcome_tree.item_history_insufficient: Integrity passes but any link fails. Preserve any improved link, close all task-derived confidence/history ledger variants, and next freeze a read-only P_t-derived latent sufficiency audit.
outcome_tree.noninterpretable: Any integrity gate fails; repair provenance or implementation without changing the contract.

stop_rules: Do not change q update, add pair ledgers, mix scalar and item history, add time/block/count/absolute-magnitude features, or tune ridge after execution.
Do not begin cross-task generalization unless v3 passes.
If v3 fails, the next experiment must derive its extra state from frozen P_t trajectories rather than another hand-built support-history feature.
